title: hybrid.rs: Yggdrasil /7 prefix incorrectly implemented as /8
description: Lines 219 and 276 check `addr[0] == 0x02` but the comment and spec say 0200::/7, which includes both 0x02 AND 0x03 first bytes. Addresses starting with 0x03 will be misclassified as External instead of MeshLocal, causing them to be dropped (if not RPL-joined) or routed via border router instead of mesh-local discovery. Fix: `(addr[0] & 0xFE) == 0x02` or `addr[0] == 0x02 || addr[0] == 0x03`.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed evidence check from dst[0] == 0x02 to (dst[0] & 0xfe) == 0x02 to correctly handle full 0200::/7 range (both 0x02 and 0x03 first bytes). Updated comments from /8 to /7. Added tests for 0x03 prefix.
